howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose position and starting number
howto.text: Position: top-left/top-center/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-center/bottom-right. Starting number: defaults to 1, but use any integer to continue a multi-document sequence.

howto.name: Apply and download
howto.text: PrivaTools stamps each page with its number in the chosen position and font size.

faq.q: Can I use Roman numerals or letters?
faq.a: Currently Arabic digits only. Roman / alpha numbering is on the roadmap.

faq.q: How is this different from Bates numbering?
faq.a: Page numbers are simple sequential digits. Bates numbers have a prefix, configurable padding, and are used in legal contexts.

faq.q: Can I start from a specific page?
faq.a: Yes — pages-to-affect lets you specify a starting page (e.g. exclude cover + TOC).
